items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: And Matthews, big Matthews was one of the guys.

ctx.x: Although I liked New York in a different way than I liked California, I always wanted to come. So after my wife came she arranged for me to make arrangements for Willie Bryant's band through the mail.

Willie would write me and tell me what he's got. How many trombones he's got. How many trumpets and what is high, certain guys can play. And Matthews, big Matthews was one of the guys. Willie always said, I've got a man that can play real high on trombone if you want to make certain notes. So I was making.......
Well I was, funnily enough, I was going to say to you, during the time now you were in China and everything, you'd been arranging more and more?
